purpose: Form BEN-2 is used by a reporting company to file a return with the Registrar regarding the declaration of significant beneficial owners in shares.
when: Within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt of the declaration by the reporting company.
steps: File the return with the Registrar along with the prescribed fees.
checklist: Prescribed fees as per Companies (Registration offices and fees) Rules, 2014
watch: The return must be filed within thirty days from the date of receipt of the declaration.
